subject: physics

hotspots.label: Top Rail
hotspots.description: The shared entry that feeds every branch straight from the battery.
hotspots.colorHint: A cool-grey horizontal rail across the top.
hotspots.function: Carries full source to each branch.

hotspots.label: Branch A
hotspots.description: First lane: its own bulb, its own complete path across the rails.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb on the far-left lane.

hotspots.label: Branch B
hotspots.description: Middle lane, full voltage, removable on its own.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb on the center lane.

hotspots.label: Branch C
hotspots.description: Right lane, still full brightness after its neighbor is removed.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm bulb on the far-right lane.

hotspots.label: Battery
hotspots.description: The source whose full volts every branch sees.
hotspots.colorHint: Small blue battery at the top rail's tail.

hotspots.label: Junction Meter
hotspots.description: Gauge that shows total current = the sum of branch currents it rejoins.
hotspots.colorHint: Round green instrument on the rejoin rail.

hotspots.label: Remove / Replace Bulb B
hotspots.description: The unplug test that leaves the other branches lit.
hotspots.colorHint: A small unscrew chip below the center bulb.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. Two cool-grey rails, three warm bulbs on separate lanes, one blue battery at the top, a green junction meter near the rejoin.
materialNotes: Metallic=0 for bulbs (warm rough glass); rails a subtle cool-grey roughness 0.3; battery faces a restrained blue cast; no bloom, no emissive.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: parallel circuit behavior on separate lanes between two shared rails.

GEOMETRY: top and bottom horizontal rails at y=1.1 and y=-0.6; three vertical branch lanes at x=-0.6,0,0.6, each carrying a bulb at y=0; battery at (-0.2,1.5,0); junction meter stand at (1.3,1.1,0.1); an unscrew chip below the middle lane.

INTERACTION: clicking either bulb flashes its meter (all full brightness); the chip removes branch B; branches A and C stay lit; reinstalling restores the trio.

NAMED NODES: TopRail, BranchA, BranchB, BranchC, Cell, JunctionMeter, RemoveChip. 8-11k tris.
